result: {"findings": [{"file": "src/completion_queue.zig", "line": 54, "severity": "major", "category": "docs", "title": "Module header still promises that a select win equals what `wait` would have returned", "body": "The module header says the future-protocol result is \"what `wait` would have returned, with one difference\" (cancellation semantics), and the `signal` field comment states that \"the future protocol depends on the strict reading of a wake: a completion is takeable, or the queue is drained.\" The diff's own comment on `getResult` documents the opposite: a stale wake can win the queue arm with the queue EMPTY and OPEN, and `error.Closed` is returned there, so the select result is NOT what `wait` would have returned. The new `isDrained` predicate exists only because of that gap. A user who reads the header and the dispatcher example (`error.Closed => break`) writes a select driver that tears down on the first stale wake, dropping operations that are still in flight — exactly the failure `isDrained` was added to prevent. The commit that defines the new required protocol is the place where the header contract has to state it."}, {"file": "src/completion_queue.zig", "line": 392, "severity": "minor", "category": "tests", "title": "New public predicate `isDrained` has no test and no caller", "body": "`isDrained` is a new public API and the discriminating case it was written for — closed with operations still in flight, where it must return `false` while `closed` alone is `true` — is never exercised. The file otherwise pins every select edge case with a test, and the existing test \"close over an in-flight operation does not wake a parked select\" already builds precisely that state (submit a 60ms timer, close, select) without asserting the predicate. Nothing in this tree calls `isDrained`, so an inverted or over-eager implementation (for example dropping the `completed.isEmpty()` term, which would report drained while a completion is still waiting to be taken) would ship green and silently make drivers stop with an undelivered completion in the queue."}]}
